scripts.text:
[Langry]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Fabres?
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
你打完50只绿棉虫了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
嗯，我觉得你还没打够50只...

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Remember, I need help hunting Fabres so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
记住，我需要你帮忙打绿棉虫，所以去打50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
你确定要停止狩猎吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
好吧，如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Please kill 50 Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
请击杀50只绿棉虫。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
真厉害，你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
I need to collect ^0000CE25 Fluff^000000 to
complete this community service project.
You know what? I can even reward you a little for helping me.
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
我需要收集^0000CE绒毛^000000来完成这个社区服务项目。
你知道吗？我甚至可以给你一点报酬作为感谢。

scripts.text: I have some Fluff
scripts.translation: 我有绒毛

scripts.text: What was that again?
scripts.translation: 刚才说什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Thank you for the Fluff. This helps me out greatly.
Oh and here you go, this should help you get stronger, faster!
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
谢谢你提供的绒毛，这帮了我大忙。
哦，给你这个，应该能让你变得更强、更快！

scripts.text:
[Langry]
I see no Fluff, wait yea I do it's the lies coming from your mouth.
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
我没看到绒毛，等等，我看到了，那是从你嘴里冒出来的谎言。

scripts.text:
[Langry]
I need ^00CE0025 Fluff^000000.

[Langry]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Fabres.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[兰格里]
啊，好吧，我想你可以帮我抓一些绿棉虫。
你想抓多少只？

scripts.text:
[Langry]
Hello, my name is Langry.
I have to complete this community service, but I am just too lazy.

我必须完成这个社区服务，但我实在太懒了。

scripts.text:

You may just be the most unlikely person ever, recycle a few Fabres and come back.
scripts.translation:

你可能是最不可思议的人了，回收一些绿棉虫然后回来吧。
